The '''2024 Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl''' was the fourth annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl, held 1–31 October 2024 on [[GEMP]].<ref name="boonta24">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1431480#p1431480 FINAL STANDINGS: 4th Annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl], post 1431480, by Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum, 8 November 2024. The 2024 forum section is titled "4th Annual Boonta Eve Jawa Brawl - October 1-31" and its description is play.starwarsccg.org.</ref> Pmj finished first among 80 players.<ref name="boonta24" />
